readings: Asynchronous reset: areset immediately forces the state to walk-left and updates outputs without waiting for a clock edge.
Synchronous reset: areset is sampled on the rising clock edge, so state and outputs update only at the next clock edge after areset=1.

ambiguities.aspect: Splatter fall-duration threshold and cycle counting
readings: Splatter occurs when the Lemming is in a fall state for 21 or more clock cycles before ground=1 (e.g., counter starts at 1 on entering fall, or condition is counter >= 20).
Splatter occurs only when the Lemming is in a fall state for 22 or more clock cycles before ground=1 (e.g., counter starts at 0 and condition is counter > 20).
The clock cycle in which ground=1 is sampled while still in a fall state counts toward the fall duration.
The clock cycle in which ground=1 is sampled does not count toward the fall duration.
Outputs are combinational functions of the current state, changing in the same cycle as the state register updates on the clock edge.
Outputs are registered, so they change one clock cycle after the state register updates.
